name: Tiandi Science & Technology Co.Ltd
summary: Tiandi Science & Technology Co.Ltd engages in the research, technology development, equipment manufacturing, engineering demonstration, testing, and inspection activities for the coal industry in China. It supplies intelligent technologies and equipment for coal mines, including intelligent mining, tunneling, and transportation, as well as mining equipment and washing equipment. The company also offers safety products, technical services, disaster management and other services for coal mine safety technology sector.
